items.title: A quantum prediction from 1931 just came to life
items.summary_raw: Nearly a century after physicist Hans Bethe predicted them, scientists have created and directly observed unusual quantum states known as “Bethe strings” in an ultracold gas. These strange clusters could contain six or more particles and even collide with one another without falling apart.
